svg.title: Michelson interferometer — refractive index
svg.desc: Editable library-based Michelson interferometer with a rotating plane-parallel glass plate and APD readout. Theta is external incidence relative to the surface normal. Phase counting determines optical path change; this is a conceptual layout. Reference: https://www.thorlabs.com/catalogpages/obsolete/2018/EDU-MINT1_M.pdf

g.inkscape:label: Title and footer
g.text: A rotating glass plate and interference-based refractive-index measurement
